display.name: Demo Dashboard
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['service_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics)
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

spec.text:
This dashboard shows RED metrics for the selected service, as generated by the spanmetrics connector in the OpenTelemetry Collector. If the selected service emits logs, the logs will also be displayed. Custom metrics generated by some services are also displayed.
Chart panels may require 5 minutes after the Demo is started before rendering data.

spec.query:
WITH if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~', toJSONString(concat('(', demo_var_service, ')')), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

WITH if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('sum by (span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", service_name=~', toJSONString(concat('(', demo_var_service, ')')), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

WITH if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')) AS demo_var_service
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('histogram_quantile(0.50, sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name=~', toJSONString(concat('(', demo_var_service, ')')), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])) by (le, span_name))'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AS time, SeverityText AS severity, count() AS count FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND (${traceId:sqlstring} = '' OR TraceId = ${traceId:sqlstring}) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT Timestamp, Body, SeverityText, ServiceName, TraceId, SpanId, ResourceAttributes, LogAttributes, EventName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND (${traceId:sqlstring} = '' OR TraceId = ${traceId:sqlstring}) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('rate(process_runtime_cpython_cpu_time_seconds_total{type=~"system"}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])*100'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "B",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('rate(process_runtime_cpython_cpu_time_seconds_total{type=~"user"}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])*100'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, 'process_runtime_cpython_memory_bytes{type="rss"}', toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, concat('rate(demo_recommendation_requests_total{recommendation_type="catalog"}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])'), toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, 'rate(otel_trace_span_processor_spans{job="quote"}[2m])*120', toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, 'sum by (service_name) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{jvm_memory_type="heap"})', toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AS time, parent.ServiceName AS caller, child.ServiceName AS callee, count() AS calls
FROM otel_traces AS child INNER JOIN otel_traces AS parent
ON child.TraceId = parent.TraceId AND child.ParentSpanId = parent.SpanId
WHERE child.Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND caller != callee
GROUP BY caller, callee ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 100
